text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 20 · 珍珠白温泉长廊.
Environment:  An original historic Alpine thermal bath, long narrow pale-aqua pool beneath cream vaulted arches, milky daylight enters through tall frosted windows and a roof lantern. Pale limestone floor, understated geometric ivory tiles, a folded white towel on a warm-brown bench to left, repeated arches recede to a small sunlit alcove. Gently steaming water with no obscuring fog, low-contrast reflections, central walkway usable. Original quiet period spa architecture, photoreal natural textures, pearl white with restrained seafoam. No swimmers, figures, statues, murals of people or faces, no dark cave mood.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 20 · 珍珠白温泉长廊. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
